context: Policy update: the footwear return window stays at 30 days, but clearance items marked Final Sale remain non-returnable. Staff should direct customers to the receipt and original box.
Updated shipping policy: standard shipping is free over $75 and $6.95 otherwise, in 5 to 7 business days. Express remains 2 business days at $19.95. International adds customer-paid duties.
Warranty policy reminder: tents carry a 2-year warranty, backpacks a lifetime limited warranty, and GPS units a 1-year warranty. Claims need proof of purchase.
Trail Rewards update: members earn 1 point per $1 and redeem 100 points for a $5 reward. Rewards now expire after 12 months. Summit tier at 1,000 points keeps free express shipping.
Price-match policy: identical items from authorized retailers are matched within 14 days of purchase. Staff verify the competitor listing before applying the adjustment.
